CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL
  MEETING AGENDA
  “We are a vibrant, livable, and inclusive community dedicated to quality services,
  safety, financial strength, sustainability, preservation, and progress
  with equal representation for our community.”

City Council Chamber  Tuesday
225 Second Street  February 13, 2024
Claremont, CA 91711
  6:30 PM

  COUNCILMEMBERS

  SAL MEDINA
  MAYOR

  JED LEANO  ED REECE  COREY CALAYCAY  JENNIFER STARK

Meetings are open to the public for in-person attendance. The meeting will be live streamed via Zoom,
technology permitting. Members of the public will not be able to provide public comment via Zoom. To
watch the meeting via Zoom, use the following link: https://zoom.us/j/256208090. To listen via telephone
dial (213)338-8477, Webinar ID: 256 208 090. The recorded meeting will be uploaded to the City
website and archived.

  OPTIONS FOR PUBLIC COMMENT

Public comment may be provided by one of the following methods. Each speaker will be given up to
three (3) minutes to provide their comment.

  IN-PERSON LIVE COMMENTS

When the item you wish to speak to is announced, please proceed to the speaker’s podium one by one.

  E-MAIL/MAIL

Written comments sent to the City Clerk’s office will be distributed to the City Council and imaged into
the record of the meeting. Email: sdesautels@ci.claremont.ca.us, jcostanza@ci.claremont.ca.us. Mail:
PO Box 880, Claremont, CA 91711. Written comments submitted after publication of the agenda will be
made available in the document archive system on the City website as soon as possible -
www.ci.claremont.ca.us.

  For assistance, comments, or more information please contact the City Clerk’s Office:
  (909) 399-5461 or (909) 399-5463.

ROLL CALL

  Claremont Helen Renwick Library Updates

FEDERAL HOLIDAYS AND OBSERVANCES

Holidays This Month and Upcoming:

  Presidents' Day, February 19, 2024

MAYOR AND COUNCIL

Council Item
1.  APPOINTMENT OF A MEMBER TO THE PLANNING COMMISSION
  Recommendation:  The 2023 City Council Ad Hoc Selection Committee recommends the City
  Council appoint K. M. (Marie) Williamson to the Planning Commission for a
  term to commence immediately and terminate on August 31, 2027.

Council Assignment Reports
City Councilmembers may serve as representatives on regional organizations. This time is
allocated for reports about their activities. For information about the Council's local,
intergovernmental  and  regional  appointments  please  visit  the  City website :
www.ci.claremont.ca.us/government/city-council/city-council-assignments-and-appointments.

CITY MANAGER REPORT

CITY ATTORNEY REPORT ON NEW LEGISLATION

PUBLIC COMMENT
The Council has set aside this time for persons who wish to comment on items that are not listed
on the agenda, but are within the jurisdiction of the City Council. Members of the public will have
the opportunity to address the City Council regarding all items on the agenda at the time the
Council considers those items.

General public comment will be taken for 30 minutes and will resume later in the meeting if there
are speakers who did not get an opportunity to speak because of the 30-minute time limit.

The Brown Act prohibits the City Council from taking action on oral requests relating to items that
 Page 3  City Council Agenda  February 13, 2024

are not on the agenda. The Council may engage in a brief discussion, refer the matter to staff,
and/or schedule requests for consideration at a subsequent meeting.

CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed on the Consent Calendar are considered routine. The City Council may act on
these items by one motion following public comment. Only Councilmembers may pull an item from
the Consent Calendar for discussion, reading of resolutions and ordinances will be waived.
2.  RESIGNATION OF POLICE COMMISSIONER RAFIK MOHAMED
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council accept with regret the resignation of
  Rafik Mohamed from the Police Commission effective immediately.
  Attachment(s):  Resignation of Police Commissioner Rafik Mohamed

3.  ADOPTION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING CITY WARRANT REGISTERS
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY
  COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, ALLOWING
  CERTAIN CLAIMS AND DEMANDS AND SPECIFYIING THE FUNDS OUT
  OF WHICH THE SAME ARE TO BE PAID, dated February 1, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving City Warrant Register Dated February 1, 2024

4.  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES OF JANUARY 23, 2024 (REGULAR) AND JANUARY 27, 2024
  (SPECIAL)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council approve the regular City Council meeting
  minutes of January 23, 2024 and the special City Council meeting minutes of
  January 27, 2024.
  Attachment(s):  Draft Regular Meeting Minutes of January 23, 2024
  Draft Special Meeting Minutes of January 27, 2024

5.  RESOLUTION APPROVING A NEGOTIATED EXCHANGE OF PROPERTY TAX REVENUES
  ASSOCIATED WITH THE ANNEXATION OF ONE SINGLE-FAMILY HOME LOCATED AT
  1123 ALAMOSA DRIVE (APN 8671-002-009) INTO COUNTY SANITATION DISTRICT NO.
  21 TO RECEIVE OFF-SITE DISPOSAL OF SEWAGE INTO THE CITY SANITARY SEWER
  SYSTEM (ANNEXATION 773)
 Page 4  City Council Agenda  February 13, 2024

  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council:
  A. Adopt A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, APPROVING AND ACCEPTING THE LOS
  ANGELES  COUNTY  SANITATION  DISTRICT'S  REQUEST  FOR  A
  NEGOTIATED EXCHANGE OF PROPERTY TAX REVENUES ASSOCIATED
  WITH ANNEXATION NO. 773, CONSISTING OF OFF-SITE DISPOSAL OF
  SEWAGE FOR ONE SINGLE-FAMILY LOT WITH ONE EXISTING
  SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCE LOCATED AT 1123 ALAMOSA DRIVE (APN
  8671-002-009);  AND  AUTHORIZING  EXECUTION  OF  A  JOINT
  RESOLUTION WITH ALL AFFECTED AGENCIES; and
  B. Find this item is exempt from environmental review under the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA).
  Attachment(s):  Resolution Approving Negotiated Exchange of Property Tax Revenues
  Proposed Annexation 773 Map

6.  AUTHORIZATION TO EXECUTE AN AMENDED INTERCREDITOR AND SUBORDINATION
  AGREEMENT BETWEEN THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, RESTORE NEIGHBORHOODS, LA,
  INC. (RNLA), AND OTHER FUNDING AGENCIES OF THE 956 BASE LINE ROAD
  AFFORDABLE AND PERMANENT SUPPORTIVE HOUSING DEVELOPMENT (FUNDING
  SOURCE: SUCCESSOR HOUSING FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute an
  amended Intercreditor and Subordination Agreement between the City of
  Claremont, RNLA, and other funding agencies of the 956 Base Line Road
  affordable and permanent supportive housing development.
  Attachment(s):  Amended Intercreditor and Subordination Agreement

7.  AUTHORIZATION  TO  AMEND  THE  EXISTING  AGREEMENT WITH EPSILON
  ENGINEERING, INC. TO INCREASE COMPENSATION FOR THE POLICE DEPARTMENT
  DISPATCH AND DETECTIVE BUREAU REMODEL PROJECT AND APPROPRIATION OF
  FUNDS (FUNDING SOURCE: AMERICAN RESCUE PLAN ACT FUND)
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends that the City Council:
  A. Authorize the City Manager to execute an amendment to the existing
  agreement with Epsilon, Inc., increasing compensation by $15,075, for a
  total not-to-exceed contract amount of $102,245 for the Police Department
  Dispatch and Detective Bureau Remodel Project; and
  B. Appropriate $15,075 from the American Rescue Plan Act (ARPA) Fund to
  fully fund the cost of the project.

PUBLIC HEARING
Public Hearings will not begin before 7:00 p.m.
8.  COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT PROGRAM - APPROVAL OF THE 2024-25
  BUDGET (FUNDING SOURCE: COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT BLOCK GRANT FUND)
 Page 5  City Council Agenda  February 13, 2024

  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council approve the program budget for the
  2024-25 Community Development Block Grant programs as proposed, and
  authorize staff to proportionately increase or decrease each program budget
  based on the final Community Development Block Grant allocation.

ORDINANCES - None

ADMINISTRATIVE ITEMS
9.  2023-24 MID-YEAR BUDGET REPORT
  Recommendation:  Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the 2023-24 Mid-Year
  Budget Report.
 Page 6  City Council Agenda  February 13, 2024

10. HUMAN  SERVICES  DEPARTMENT  NAME  CHANGE  (FUNDING  SOURCE:  GENERAL
  FUND)
  Recommendation:  The Community and Human Services Commission recommends the City
  Council approve renaming the "Human Services Department" to "Recreation
  and Human Services Department."
  Attachment(s):  Excerpt from the 02-07-24 CHS Commission Minutes (Draft)

CONTINUED PUBLIC COMMENT
This time is reserved for those persons who were unable to speak earlier in the agenda because
of the 30-minute time restriction.

COMMISSIONS/COMMITTEES

  One Community and Human Services Commission Vacancy (Appointment Pending)
  One Police Commission Vacancy
  One Traffic and Transportation Commission Vacancy
  One Public Art Committee Vacancy
  One Sustainability Committee Vacancy

ADJOURNMENT

THE NEXT REGULAR MEETING OF THE CLAREMONT CITY COUNCIL WILL BE HELD ON,
FEBRUARY 27, 2024, AT 6:30 P.M., IN THE CLAREMONT COUNCIL CHAMBER, 225 WEST
SECOND STREET, CLAREMONT, CA 91711.

A LOOK AHEAD – Upcoming Meetings and Tentative Agenda Items

  - Tri-City Care Court Presentation
  - Resolution Approving February 15, 2024 City Warrant Register
  - City Council Meeting Minutes of February 13 (Special and Regular)
  - Confirmation of City Council 2024-26 Priorities and Objectives
  - Resolution Authorizing 2023-24 Landscape and Lighting District Annual Report Preparation
  - Houseal Lavigne 6th Cycle Housing Element Contract Amendment
  - Police Department Boiler Replacement

IN COMPLIANCE WITH THE AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES ACT 0F 1990, THIS AGENDA WILL
BE MADE AVAILABLE IN APPROPRIATE ALTERNATIVE FORMATS TO PERSONS WITH
DISABILITIES. ANY PERSON WITH A DISABILITY WHO REQUIRES A MODIFICATION OR
ACCOMMODATION IN ORDER TO PARTICIPATE IN A CITY MEETING SHOULD CONTACT THE
CITY CLERK AT 909-399-5461 “VOICE” OR 1-800-735-2929 “TT/TTY” AT LEAST THREE (3)
WORKING DAYS PRIOR TO THE MEETING, IF POSSIBLE. I, SHELLEY DESAUTELS, CITY CLERK
OF THE CITY OF CLAREMONT, CALIFORNIA, HEREBY CERTIFY UNDER PENALTY OF PERJURY
THAT THE FOREGOING AGENDA WAS POSTED AT CLAREMONT CITY HALL, 207 HARVARD
